newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Spot Saudi riyal eases against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Spot Saudi riyal eases against dollar.

text.p: The spot Saudi riyal eased against the dollar this week as foreign oil firms sought to buy dollars for riyals, dealers in the kingdom said.
"Some foreign oil companies are buying dollars for riyals, pushing the spot riyal to slide," one Riyadh-based dealer said.
The spot Saudi riyal was quoted at 3.7506/08 to the dollar, down from 3.7504/06 last week.
Dealers said short-dated Saudi riyal interbank rates climbed 1/16 to 1/8 point caused by tight liquidity in the short dates. They put spot-next and one-week funds at 5-3/4, 5/8 percent.
Other riyal interbank deposit rates were mainly unchanged.
One-month deposit rates were put at 5-13/16, 11/16 percent, three months were at 5-15/16, 13/16 percent, six months were at 6-1/16, 5-15/16 percent and one-year funds were at 6-5/16, 3/16 percent.
